title: 第9章 黑狼拳精通第10章 精力丸
slug: 开局黑狼拳简化后让我学狼叫
content_zh:
这头野猪重量大概三百斤左右，算是野猪中的中等体格。
这么多肉，总能填饱李大龙的胃口吧。
“射箭！”赵寒轻声道。
一名猎手当即张弓搭箭，瞄准了野猪。
“嗖！”
一箭射出，却偏了准头，射在野猪脚下的石块上。
“哄哄……”野猪怪叫着转头，赵寒几人快速低头，避免被野猪看到。
野猪的战斗力可不弱，算是杂食动物的天花板级别。
皮糙肉厚，獠牙尖锐，速度达到40公里每小时，冲击力很强，能直接把野狼撞成残废，负伤后更是越战越勇。
哪怕是一名炼皮武者，没有持有兵器的情况下，单对单也不是野猪的对手。
赵寒可不想正面交锋，而是想消耗野猪。
野猪并未发现赵寒等人，转头“哼哼”了两声，便准备离开。
“嗖！”
又是一箭射来。
这一箭一发入魂，径直射进了野猪的右前腿，顿时鲜血洒出。
“嗷嗷……”野猪吃痛怒叫，原地蹦哒。
“继续射！”
这时候是痛打落水狗的好时机。
“嗖！”
又是一发箭矢射来，正中没有防备的野猪的下颚。

“嗷嗷……”
野猪剧痛，疯狂甩动前半身嚎叫。
“继续射，耗死它。”
帮众继续射箭。
“嗖”的一声，一箭射了过去，可这次被野猪发现了。
野猪一个窜动躲开箭矢，随后朝林中奔袭过来。
虽说右前腿受了伤，速度受到限制，却丝毫不影响野猪的气势。
“快躲树上去，等野猪流血而亡。”赵寒立刻喊道，随后拉着树枝便引体向上爬到了树上。
其他五人身手也不错，立刻爬树躲避。
持弓的帮众继续射击。
野猪一番冲势没有起到作用，对着几人嗷嗷叫，并躲开箭矢。
“嗷！”
怒吼一声，野猪跑开了十几米，随后对着一棵一人环抱的树干冲来。
野猪撞不到人，就会撞树。
“砰！”
快速冲来，脑袋撞击在树上，树干沉稳，野猪却被撞得头晕眼花。
一击不得，野猪伤势反倒是越来越重，似乎知道耗在这里没有办法，便转身准备逃跑。
帮众再次射箭，阻拦野猪并激怒它。
content_en:
This wild boar weighs about three hundred kilograms and is considered to be of medium build among wild boars.
This much meat can always satisfy Li Dalong's appetite.
"Arrow!" Zhao Han said softly.
A hunter immediately drew his bow and arrow and aimed at the wild boar.
"Whoosh!"
An arrow was shot, but it missed its target and hit the stone at the boar's feet.
"Coax..." The wild boar screamed and turned its head. Zhao Han and others quickly lowered their heads to avoid being seen by the wild boar.
The fighting power of wild boars is not weak, it is considered the ceiling level of omnivores.
It has rough skin and thick flesh, sharp fangs, can reach speeds of 40 kilometers per hour, and has a strong impact. It can directly knock wild wolves into disability. After being injured, it becomes more and more courageous as it fights.
Even a skin-refining warrior is no match for a wild boar in a one-on-one situation without holding a weapon.
Zhao Han did not want a head-on confrontation, but wanted to consume the wild boar.
The wild boar didn't notice Zhao Han and the others, turned around and "hummed" twice before preparing to leave.
"Whoosh!"
Another arrow came.
This arrow shot straight into the wild boar's right front leg, and blood immediately spilled out.
"Ouch..." The wild boar roared in pain and jumped on the spot.
"Keep cumming!"
This is a good time to beat up the drowned dog.
"Whoosh!"
Another arrow was fired, hitting the unsuspecting wild boar in the lower jaw.
"Ouch..."
The wild boar was in severe pain, wildly shaking its front body and howling.
"Keep shooting and wear it out."
The gang members continued to shoot arrows.
With a "swish" sound, an arrow was shot, but this time the wild boar discovered it.
The wild boar scurried to avoid the arrow, and then rushed towards the forest.
Although the right front leg was injured and its speed was limited, it did not affect the wild boar's momentum at all.
"Hide in the tree and wait for the wild boar to bleed to death." Zhao Han shouted immediately, then pulled the branch and climbed up the tree.
The other five people were also very skilled and immediately climbed trees to escape.
The gang members holding bows continued to shoot.
The wild boar's momentum had no effect. It howled at several people and dodged the arrows.
"Ouch!"
With an angry roar, the wild boar ran away for more than ten meters, and then rushed towards a tree trunk surrounded by a person.
If a wild boar cannot hit a person, it will hit a tree.
"Bang!"
He rushed over quickly and hit his head on the tree. The tree trunk was steady, but the wild boar was knocked dizzy.
Without a single blow, the wild boar's injuries became more and more serious. It seemed that it knew that there was nothing that could be done here, so it turned around and prepared to escape.
The gang shoots arrows again to stop the boar and anger it.
